mcp.title: Agent connection (MCP)
mcp.intro: An AI agent such as Claude Code can connect to this app and work on the open project. It connects to this address:
mcp.badHost: The host must be a name or an address, such as 127.0.0.1.
mcp.badPort: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
mcp.exposed: Anyone who can reach this address can control the app: there is no password. Use 127.0.0.1 unless you know you need something else.
mcp.connect: Press play to set the agent up with this server. Running it again after a port change updates the entry.
mcp.local: There is no password: only programs on this computer can connect.
mcp.desktopOnly: The agent connection is only available in the desktop app.

findings.watertight: Watertight: every edge is shared by exactly two triangles.
findings.inverted: Normals are inverted: the model is inside-out.
findings.degenerate: {{detail}} degenerate triangles removed from the check.
findings.shells: {{detail}} separate shells: loose parts each need support.
findings.tooBig: Does not fit the printer volume in any orientation.
findings.noThin: No walls thinner than {{limit}} mm found.
findings.thin: Thin walls: {{n}} region(s), thinnest {{min}} mm, ~{{area}} mm² below {{limit}} mm. Brittle or may not print.
findings.noGaps: No gaps narrower than {{limit}} mm found.
findings.gaps: Narrow gaps: {{n}} region(s), narrowest {{min}} mm, ~{{area}} mm² closer than {{limit}} mm. May fill with resin.
findings.selfInt: {{detail}} pair(s) of crossing triangles: the surface cuts through itself.
findings.fillNoFeed: Casting fill check skipped: no mass thicker than {{detail}} mm to feed from.
findings.fillOk: Casting fill: every thin section is close to a thick mass.
findings.fill: Casting fill: thin sections up to {{worst}} mm from any thick mass (limit {{reach}} mm). The metal may freeze before filling them.
findings.deepSkipped: Thickness, gap and intersection checks skipped: fix the problems above first.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Frederic Coultier
onboarding.about1: A jewelry design studio driven by an AI agent. Describe a ring, a pendant or earrings; the agent writes the model, you watch it appear in 3D.
onboarding.about2: It checks the piece for casting and printing, adds supports and a sprue, and exports files ready to produce. Projects are saved as .fc files.
onboarding.modeTitle: How do you want to work with the agent?
onboarding.modeHint: Both use the same tools. The difference is where you talk to the agent.
onboarding.later: You can change this any time in Preferences.

chat.name: Agent chat
chat.what: Type your prompts directly in the app. A chat panel opens next to the editor and the preview.
chat.how: Uses Claude Code or Codex, with the account you are already signed in with on this computer. The agent sees and edits the open project, and you see every change as it happens.

mcp.name: MCP only
mcp.what: No chat panel. The app only offers its tools, and you talk to your own agent somewhere else.
mcp.how: While the app runs it serves a local MCP endpoint. Connect Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client to it (Preferences → Agent connection) and work from its terminal or editor. Changes show up live in the app.
